configurations.name: promedia
runtimeArgs:
import os, uvicorn; from promedia.config import load as load_config; from promedia.core.credentials import CredentialStore; from promedia.web.app import create_app; cfg = load_config(); cfg.values['web']['port'] = int(os.environ.get('PORT', cfg.get('web', 'port'))); store = CredentialStore(); token = store.ensure_operator_token(); host = str(cfg.get('web', 'host')); port = int(cfg.get('web', 'port')); print(f'
ProMedia UI. Open this URL to authenticate as the operator:
  http://{host}:{port}/?token={token}
', flush=True); uvicorn.run(create_app(cfg, store=store), host=host, port=port, access_log=False)
